# the same failure three times with a fresh explanation each time

Three attempts on one slice, each with a confidently-worded new hypothesis, each producing
the identical normalised error fingerprint.

Three failures fixing three different causes is work. One failure three times with recycled
guesses is flailing, and the difference is not visible from inside the third attempt.
